# FontCache

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Process-wide tuning for the parsed-font cache. Reading and parsing a font file (its character map, widths and kerning) is repeated work for every document that uses it, so fonts loaded from a file path are kept after the first document and reused until the file changes. Fonts supplied as byte arrays are parsed once per array and need no setting: the parse is kept for exactly as long as the array.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`MaxFiles`](#maxfiles): The most font files kept parsed in memory at once; the least recently loaded is dropped first.

### `MaxFiles`

```csharp
static int MaxFiles { get; set; }
```

*static*

The most font files kept parsed in memory at once; the least recently loaded is dropped first. Each costs roughly the size of the font file plus its character map. Set to `0` to turn the cache off, so every document reads and parses its fonts afresh. Defaults to 16.

## Methods

- [`Clear`](#clear): Drops cached parsed font files and compressed embedding programs.
